original.target_description: Study 1: camp-size main effect on preference ratings, 2 × 2 within-subjects ANOVA; small versus large Rwanda camp, averaging domestic comparison programs.

n.sample_role: participants in target analysis; analytic n unestablished
n.exclusions: 54 volunteers are reported, but target F(1,52) is inconsistent with that total; no analytic n explicitly established. No participant exclusion explanation found.

replication.target_description: Study 1c: post-exclusion camp-size main effect on aid preferences in South Sudan, two-way within-subjects ANOVA; larger versus smaller refugee camp.

n.quote: The final sample after exclusions involved 437 MTurk participants
n.exclusions: 451 complete responses; four excluded for low seriousness, eight for failed comprehension, two for suboptimal English understanding (p. 29 footnote).

es.location: author manuscript p. 32 (PDF p. 35), Replication results

p.location: author manuscript p. 32 (PDF p. 35), Replication results

reported_success.quote:
We successfully replicated our results in Studies 1a and 1b in this study with a

different refugee context but failed to replicate the results of the original study.

notes: Author preprint pagination differs from supplied p. 9. Extracted main-text post-exclusion analysis (437), not supplementary pre-registered-exclusions-only analysis (447). No d printed for this main-text target; partial eta-squared retained. Summary Table 13 reports 0.12 for Study 1c, differing from main-text 0.09; kept the statistic paired with main-text F and p. Original prints F, no d; no conversion.
